pr_title: usb: hid: remove get_protocol/set_protocol from USB HID class API
pr_body:
The USB HID class API offers the possibility to register callbacks
for Get/SetIdle, Get/SetProtocol to the application.
Rules for these callbacks are neither obvious nor documented.

This patch remove this possibility to register Get/SetProtocol
and Get/SetIdle callbacks for the following reasons:

The possibility to call unknown application code while processing
control requests should be avoided or reduced to a minimum.

The Get/SetProtocol callbacks are redundant and do not provide any
additional value since the way to inform the application
about the change of the protocol exists via the callback
hid_protocol_cb_t protocol_change.

The core provides implementation to handle Get/SetIdle requests and
on idle reports. If this is not suitable in any way then the application
should implement everything itself.

Fixes #34426

issue_context.title: RFC: API Change: USB HID remove get_protocol/set_protocol/get_idle/set_idle callbacks
issue_context.body:
USB HID remove get_protocol/set_protocol/get_idle/set_idle callbacks from stable API

### Problem description

The USB HID class API offers the possibility to register callbacks
for Get/SetIdle, Get/SetProtocol to the application.
Rules for these callbacks are neither obvious nor documented.

The Get/SetProtocol callbacks are redundant and do not provide any
additional value since the way to inform the application
about the change of the protocol exists via the callback
hid_protocol_cb_t protocol_change.

The core provides implementation to handle Get/SetIdle requests and
on idle reports. If this is not suitable in any way then the application
should implement everything itself.

Also the possibility to call unknown application code while processing
control requests should also be avoided or reduced to a minimum.

Example that it can be used all wrong: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/34400/files

### Proposed change + RFC

https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/33659

### Dependencies

The probability that someone will be affected is very low, since the usage is neither necessary nor obvious.

review_comments: I think Get/SetReport callbacks should also be removed because of the same reason and the callback signature for set_report is wrong as no data is transferred to host. If at some point an interface for feature reports is needed we can then implement it reasonably.
